correctness.rationale: Dirichlet gamma moments and differentiated beta integrals give explicit E(H), E(Q), E(HQ). Cancelling and using the digamma recurrence yields the displayed weighted covariance. Positive weights and strict monotonicity of digamma imply the heterogeneity term is >=0, equality exactly symmetric; the rational baseline is positive for k>=2. Analytic proof covers every real positive parameter; 266 separate exact-rational, quadrature and simulation checks corroborate critical algebra. No finite test is asserted to prove the unrestricted claim.

value.rationale: Shannon and Simpson/Gini diversity are standard distinct indices for uncertainty in species-frequency distributions and categorical Bayesian inference. The theorem resolves their exact posterior/prior co-fluctuation and a universal sign for all concentration heterogeneity, plus a quantitative sharp lower bound and an equality characterization. Since entropy and collision are not deterministically oppositely ordered in dimension three, the stochastic dependence sign is genuinely structural rather than a routine pointwise inequality. No broad downstream theorem is assumed.
